reviews.title: Not only useless, but punitive
reviews.text: Not only. Does this Blocker, NOT block but now the sites I used it on have punitive ads for all of us with Ad blockers.   For instance if you have THIS app, on Safari,   But the sites somehow blow right past any blocking and send disgusting ads with images of constipation for these random BS cures for ailments, like back pain, constipation, and other offensive, and false ads for giimmicks, etc.   There are hundreds of them that come through, even with blockers. My choice now to see my favorite sites with news I want and politics I follow, is to NOT have a blocker and let the damn ads follow.     I had no idea, or I forgot I was actually paying for this useless app.    I cancelled today for good.     Two sites that send all of us with blockers, this offensive material is Gateway Pundits and all JD Rucker publications, which are numerous.    Frustrated and I still can’t believe I was paying for the Ad blocker.

reviews.text:
Gotta hand it to you guys, charging money for an ad-blocker that doesn’t block ads is genius!

Don’t bother with the canned developer response I’ve seen in other reviews. I’ve done all those steps in settings before and I am using Safari, your product simply sucks! And it’s getting worse, as I’m seeing more and more ads on the same sites.

Edit: Thanks for the canned developer response I specifically said not to bother with!

I’ve canceled my subscription, because the ad blocker by Ad Blocker Labs is free, and works despite the application not being updated in some time. You do have to go into the application and manually update the block lists, but that’s nothing compared to $12-a-year down the drain!
